explication: Lemonade is a local AI inference server with a desktop management and experimentation app, plus CLI and standard API clients. The principal workflow is selecting or downloading a model, preparing/loading it, sending a chat or multimodal request, and receiving generated output. The graph preserves model/backend management, custom collections and routing, and inference modalities. Runtime ownership is only partially visible in the supplied excerpts; unverified server-internal links are dashed rather than inferred as calls.
